editorial:
Imagine being stuck on a freezing mountain with no food, no help, and no way out. You are part of a young rugby team from Uruguay whose plane just crashed into the snowy peaks of the Andes. You quickly realize that the world has no idea where you are, and the cold is trying to kill you every single second. The movie does a great job of making you feel the desperation of these guys as they try to keep their spirits up while facing the hardest choice a human being could ever make just to stay alive.

The acting is solid and makes the bond between the teammates feel real. While some of the special effects look a bit dated now, the tension keeps you glued to your seat. It is a heavy watch, but it is incredibly inspiring to see how far the human mind can go to survive. It is definitely a story that sticks with you long after the credits roll.
endingExplained: After spending over two months in the mountains, Nando Parrado and Roberto Canessa realize they cannot wait for rescue. They hike for ten days across the giant peaks without any gear. They finally find a Chilean shepherd by a river. This leads to a massive rescue mission where the remaining survivors are flown to safety. The movie ends with the heartbreaking but happy reunion of the survivors and their families back home.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true stories about survival and the human spirit.
